_about: Notes on terms of config/ngsi-ld-context.json. Kept apart because JSON-LD 1.1 forbids extra keys in term definitions; never served.

notes.@context: Nekazari Platform NGSI-LD @context. One platform namespace: https://nkz-os.org/ns/ (prefix nkz:). Terms with an official Smart Data Model or SAREF4AGRI IRI map there; everything else is a platform extension under nkz:. Do not introduce a second self-namespace: changing a term's IRI re-expands the attribute in the broker and orphans data already written under the old one.
notes.AgriCropObservation: Platform extension of SDM AgriCrop (which lacks observation/image capture semantics).
notes.AgriDevice: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Legacy device type used by DaTaK setup scripts. Prefer AgriSensor for new entities.
notes.AgriEnergyTracker: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy production/consumption tracking for agricultural installations.
notes.AgriEquipment: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for generic agricultural equipment. Used as parent type for tractors and implements.
notes.AgriOperation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriOperation.
notes.AgriParcel: SAREF4AGRI AgriParcel — canonical type used by GIS-Routing for parcel creation. Legacy mapping: nkz:AgriParcel.
notes.AgriParcelOperation: Platform extension — SDM AgriParcelOperation lacks agricultural machinery kinematics properties. Platform extends with A-B lines and VRA fields.
notes.AgriPlant: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): individual plant (tree, vine, shrub) followed over time
notes.AgriPlantSample: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): plant tissue sample with laboratory results
notes.AgriRobot: Alias for AgriculturalRobot — both resolve to nkz:AgriculturalRobot. Robotics module uses AgriRobot as entity type. Standardized 2026-05-08.
notes.AgriSensor: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no AgriSensor class (only specific sensor types like Pluviometer, Thermometer). Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriSensor.
notes.AgriSoilExtended: SDM-001 Proposal: Extension of AgriSoil with soil horizon data and pedotransfer function properties (LUCAS/SoilGrids integration)
notes.AgriSoilSample: SDM proposal (smart-data-models/incubated#283): soil sample of one depth interval with laboratory results
notes.AgriculturalImplement: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural implements. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalImplement.
notes.AgriculturalMachine: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Generic agricultural machinery parent type for tractors and implements.
notes.AgriculturalRobot: Platform extension — no equivalent in SAREF4AGRI or any SDM catalog. Alias: AgriRobot (robotics module) maps to same nkz:AgriculturalRobot URI. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalRobot.
notes.AgriculturalTractor: Platform extension — no SDM type exists for agricultural tractors. Closest: ManufacturingMachine. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:AgriculturalTractor.
notes.Alert: Platform extension — sensor health alert entity. Created by sensor-health-beat when reliabilityStatus transitions to error and isSilenced==false.
notes.CarbonStock: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Soil organic carbon stock assessment per parcel.
notes.CropHealthAssessment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Crop health evaluation result from epidemiological models.
notes.Device: Official SDM dataModel.Device. Canonical type for a provisioned physical sensor. Replaces the platform extension AgriSensor.
notes.DeviceCommand: Platform extension — MQTT device command tracking. Records command lifecycle (pending -> sent/failed) for IoT device management.
notes.DeviceMeasurement: Official SDM dataModel.Device. Canonical carrier for a reading. One entity per (device, controlledProperty), overwritten; history lives in TimescaleDB.
notes.DigitalAsset: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. LiDAR point cloud and 3D model assets.
notes.DiseaseRiskAssessment: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Proposed for FIWARE Smart Data Models AgriFood domain (P1). Daily disease risk evaluation per parcel.
notes.EOProduct: FIWARE Smart Data Model — Earth Observation product (Sentinel-1 GRD, Sentinel-2 NDVI, etc.). Properties: productType, hasAgriParcel, backscatterVV, backscatterVH, ndviValue, dateObserved.
notes.EnergyMeter: Platform extension — no SDM equivalent. Energy metering device for Odoo ERP integration.
notes.EnergyStorageSystem: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:EnergyStorageSystem.
notes.LivestockAnimal: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no LivestockAnimal class. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockAnimal.
notes.LivestockFarm: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockFarm.
notes.LivestockGroup: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockGroup.
notes.LivestockProduction: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:LivestockProduction.
notes.ManufacturingMachine: Official SDM. Canonical type for tractors, implements and field robots, discriminated by the category attribute. Already consumed by gis-routing.
notes.PhotovoltaicInstallation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:PhotovoltaicInstallation.
notes.RiskAssessment: Platform extension — generic risk evaluation result for batch-evaluated risks (robotic, energy, livestock, agronomic). Disease-specific risks use DiseaseRiskAssessment.
notes.SatelliteImageObservation: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:SatelliteImageObservation.
notes.SoilDerivedRaster: SDM-004 Proposal: Raster derived from point samples or gridded soil models (COG/NetCDF storage)
notes.SoilSamplingPoint: SDM-002 Proposal: Point sample location with laboratory analysis results and spatial reference
notes.SoilSurvey: SDM-003 Proposal: Survey campaign metadata (instrumentation, point count, spatial coverage)
notes.VegetationIndex: Platform extension — no SAREF4AGRI equivalent. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:VegetationIndex.
notes.WaterQualityObserved: Official SDM dataModel.WaterQuality. Nitrate content of irrigation water, credited in the nutrient plan.
notes.WeatherForecast: SDM oficial dataModel.Weather. Lleva los agregados diarios (dayMinimum/dayMaximum) que WeatherObserved no define: el SDM modela WeatherObserved como observación instantánea.
notes.WeatherObserved: Platform extension — SAREF4AGRI has no WeatherObserved. SDM WeatherObserved exists in dataModel.Weather. Legacy mapping: saref4agri:WeatherObserved.
notes.controlledAsset: Official SDM Device property. The asset a device monitors — sole canonical device-to-parcel link. Replaces the platform-specific parcelId property.
